apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(player): add Play on my TV to title and stream menus, remembering the chosen TV (`68e4119d`)
- feat(addons): add enable toggle to addon cards and show catalog count (`2cd93b9e`)
- feat(settings): offer 74 languages and the new track options in the language pickers (`fd7f628d`)
- feat(ui): scroll long choice menus on phone, TV and desktop (`4d71b2a8`)
- feat(player): add default, device, original and forced track options (`ace81b75`)
- fix(android): pass Nuvio, MDBList and sync keys to the release build (`b6b9d7ad`)
- feat(home): count seasons and episodes in the series meta line (`1074e9f3`)
- feat(detail): show seasons and the episode to play in the detail modal and enlarge its synopsis (`eb3147cd`)
- fix(settings): keep imported badge packs and formatter presets listed and stop layout fields reusing formatter rows (`756b71e1`)
- feat(home): show only resolution, HDR and audio badges in square chips on the hero (`e561cfa9`)
- feat(settings): add a cinema outline theme for stream badges (`d82b6767`)
- feat(home): show stream badges after the hero metadata (`3563963c`)
- fix(settings): turn poster overlays and stream badges off by default (`288daa93`)
- fix(desktop): enlarge the sidebar logo (`4298d169`)
- fix(home): use the logo the catalog returns and stop fetching logos from TMDB (`0841eb08`)
- feat(settings): add the content type to hero catalog names (`d71b705d`)
- fix(settings): resolve hero catalog names from the Home feed keys (`c819efdf`)
- f
